pages.text: There is $(bold)no random ore$(). Geolosys places metal in deposits — plutons — each of one kind, each large, and each somewhere specific. Iron may be a ten-minute walk; zinc may be the next valley over.$(br2)This is deliberate. Ore that is somewhere else is why wagons, ships and eventually trains exist.

Look for $(bold)samples$(): small rock clusters on the surface that show what is below. Dig straight down from a sample and you will find the deposit.$(br2)Ore blocks drop $(bold)clusters$(), not raw ore. Smelt them, or run them through Create's crushing wheels for more.
